description: Engagement target credential cases (RCF-R184). references are JSON texts of RuntimeCredentialRef, the exact reference to one immutable target credential revision: Go (runtimesettings.RuntimeCredentialRef through contracts.DecodePrivateStrict), the Runtime (decode_private of RuntimeCredentialRef) and the private schema allocation.schema.json#/$defs/RuntimeCredentialRef reach the verdict valid. materials are the creation material of each target kind: the Server's constructors and stored-plaintext decoding (internal/credentials), the public create request (internal/httpapi/public) and the public OpenAPI material schema reach the verdict valid. A case is the JSON text text, the raw bytes hex (not UTF-8) or the JSON value material, whose fill members are strings of count repetitions of unit set at the JSON Pointer pointer. schema accepts records an invalid case that a JSON Schema cannot reject: a repeated key, which a JSON parser collapses, a lone surrogate escape, a UTF-8 byte bound over multi-byte characters, the aggregate login value bound or the 32 KiB bound of the canonical JSON plaintext; every other case gets the verdict valid from the schema, and text that is not one JSON value is rejected by all. Only the Server reads materials: the Runtime receives no target material until a private identity projection carries it.
